title: Victoria Whale Watching Tour by Zodiac
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Tours are subject to weather conditions and passenger demand
Zodiac boats are not for expectant mothers
Zodiac boats are not recommended for those with health concerns - neck, back, hip or knee injuries or recent surgeries
All guests must be over the age of 7 and/or over 4.5' or 130 cm in height
We recommend dressing in warm layers with closed-toe shoes to ensure a comfortable experience.
Zodiac passenger under age 19 must be accompanied by a Parent or Legal Guardian who will sign a Waiver on their behalf
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the beauty of the Salish Sea and Vancouver Island's rugged coastline onboard a Zodiac! This 3-hour whale watching tour is perfect for people who want to experience an exhilarating ride in the open air! 

Keep your eyes open for orcas, humpback whales, gray whales and other marine wildlife like seals and sea lions! Enjoy views of the Salish Sea with your expert guide who will make sure you enjoy a safe, fun and informative experience!
